S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 future settled 1084.8, down 4.8 points (-0.44%) on 23 Jul, extending its retreat from the 1096.6 high on Jul 21. Put OI outweighs calls 1.99:1 (25,519 vs 12,817), the richest put skew of the week, while the P/C volume ratio flipped to 1.74 (put-heavy flow) from 0.82 (call-heavy) yesterday. Max pain has held at 1060 for a 4th straight session, now 24.8 points below spot, while cumulative dealer gamma stays negative below strike 1110, keeping spot inside a short-gamma zone. The 25-delta skew reverted to +0.97 (put-rich) from -0.71 (call-rich) yesterday, matching today's fresh downside move with fresh downside-hedging demand.
what_changed: Future fell 4.8 points to 1084.8, a 2nd straight down session and -11.8 points off the Jul 21 high of 1096.6.
25-delta skew flipped back to +0.97 (put-rich) from -0.71 (call-rich) yesterday - the downside-hedging bid returned alongside the drop.
P/C volume ratio reversed to 1.74 (put-heavy) from 0.82 (call-heavy), the flow direction flipped in a single session.
Total put OI rose to 25,519 (+3.5%) while call OI slipped to 12,817 (-1.1%), pushing the P/C OI ratio to a weekly high of 1.99.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has been glued to 1060 across all 4 recorded sessions (Jul 17-23) even as spot round-tripped from 1088.7 to a Jul 21 high of 1096.6 and back down to 1084.8 today, reaffirming it as a stable anchor. The gamma-flip strike has held a tight 1096-1110 band the whole week, and spot has stayed below it every session, so the desk has been continuously short-gamma, not newly so. Put OI grew 21% over the window (21,045 to 25,519) versus call OI's 8% growth (11,881 to 12,817), pushing the P/C OI ratio from 1.77 to 1.99 and the deep 910 structural put hedge from 8,289 to 9,510 contracts (+14.7%). The near put wall (1050) and near call wall (1100) have both held through the week, keeping spot boxed inside them, and today's skew reversal back to put-rich (+0.97, from -0.71) shows the latest leg down is drawing genuine hedging demand rather than fading it. Net-net: a persistent short-gamma coil inside a stable 1050-1100 box, with put-side OI accumulating steadily underneath rather than resolving in either direction.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1090P / 1050P
strategies.rationale: Today's -4.8 point drop plus dealer short gamma below the 1110 flip amplifies (not fades) continuation toward the 1060 max pain and 1050 wall, and the skew's reversion to +0.97 put-rich confirms fresh hedging demand.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid: 1090P ask 22.5 minus 1050P bid 12.5 = 10.0 points.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1100 near call wall reasserts the upper half of the box and negates the bearish continuation thesis.

strategies.name: Long strangle 1050 put / 1130 call
strategies.rationale: Dealer short gamma across the whole 1050-1100 box means a break out of the range in either direction gets amplified, not faded, so long premium captures that cheaply while today's 13.39% IV stays low.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = total premium paid: 1050P ask 12.9 + 1130C ask 8.7 = 21.6 points.
strategies.invalidation: Spot pins inside the 1050-1100 box through the 68-day expiry window without IV expansion; theta steadily erodes the position.

S50U26.prediction: Bias: mildly bearish-neutral inside the 1050-1100 box - today's -4.8 point drop plus the reverted put-rich skew (+0.97) favor a continued drift toward the 1060 max pain and 1050 near put wall over the next 1-2 sessions. A daily close below 1050 would confirm a short-gamma squeeze lower toward the deep 910 structural floor; a close back above 1100 reopens the range toward the 1080/1130 call cluster and negates the bearish lean. Watch the 9.15-point 1-sigma range around 1084.8 (roughly 1075.7-1093.95) for the next session's directional tell.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not a trade recommendation. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the pinning/max-pain mechanics here are structurally weaker than for share-settled single-stock options; treat every wall, the 1060 max pain, and the 1050-1100 box as a tendency, not a guarantee, especially with 68 days still left to the Sep 29 expiry.
